capabilities: Write worlds in age code blocks and get generated descriptions and stability
Render animated procedural linking windows for each world
Open flippable descriptive and linking books with generated covers
Furnish a Myst-style refuge with shelf, telescope, Imager and puzzles
Chart stars and map linked Ages on a canvas
disambiguation: Not an AI or grammar writing assistant; it generates procedural worlds from code blocks you write, with no network or AI at runtime.
extras: Free, non-commercial fan project under Cyan's fan content policy; not reviewed by Obsidian staff; mobile support is new (iOS untested) and dark themes get less testing; optional user-provided sound files and D'ni font.
motivation: Built as a fan tribute to the Myst series and the Mystcraft idea of linking to a world rather than creating one.
problem: Obsidian has no diegetic worldbuilding tool where writing a world in plain lines deterministically generates its description, physics, visuals and exploration journal.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the Myst series (and the Mystcraft idea of linking to a world rather than creating one).

summary: World-writing plugin that turns age code blocks into described worlds with stability, animated linking windows, books, and a Myst-style refuge.
